d:
Indian and Chinese troops have reportedly faced off at multiple locations along the Line of Actual Control (LAC) in Arunachal Pradesh. Indo-Tibetan Border Police Director General Shatrujeet Kapur confirmed that the face-offs had taken place and that the situation continued.
According to reports, the latest tensions involve areas near Asaphila and Taksing in the Upper Subansiri district. The Ministry of External Affairs has said that friction points typically emerge when Chinese forces depart from established patrolling patterns.
